mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eastwood_reservation ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, phone VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, guests INTEGER NOT NULL, book_date VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, book_time VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, guests, book_date, book_time FROM eastwood_reservation ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eastwood_reservation (name, phone, guests, book_date, book_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{guests}, #{bookDate}, #{bookTime})
